author: Adityaraj Mehta
content:
Hi Harsh ! 
How long did the final stretch take ? Upward from the Iron ladder ? 
We're a group of 4 friends planning to go shoot some astrophotography. So wanted to know how safe it is to stay up there without a campfire ? And how strenuous is the climb, considering we'll be carrying moderately heavy equipment.
Thanks in advance !

author: Harsh
content:
Hi Aditya,
The final stretch will take somewhere around 30-45 mins, if you don't take any break.
It's perfectly safe to stay there (with or without a campfire). I would not suggest a campfire as it might be a bit of risk.
Perfect spot for astrophotography and capturing the dawn. 
The climb is pretty simple and you can take multiple pit stops at the plateaus en route.
P.S. carry 2 bedsheets per person as it might get a little cold around dawn. Happy trekking :)

author: Prasham Parikh
content:
Hey Harsh!
I'm planning to go to Kalsubhai this weekend with 6-7 friends. Would you tell me the best way to reach there? And how safe is it for us to camp on our own at night out there? Could you possibly give me all the details please?

author: Harsh
content:
Hi Prasham,

Please find below the itinerary that you can follow:

- Take a local to Kasara (target to reach the station latest by 6 in the evening - try to reach by around 4:30 if you do not have a prior arrangement for cab at Kasara station)
- Take a cab / jeep from the station to "Bari Village" (it will take over an hour and around 70-80 bucks per head)
- Explore the village, have some food and start for the Trek by around 9 (ask the local for the directions. The route is not very complex and can be done without any problems)
- You will encounter two plateaus on your way. Suggest to treat them as pit stops and enjoy the ambiance (Target a full moon night :))
- Reach the pinnacle around 1 and camp for the night 
- Try to stay awake. The place takes various forms through the night to lead a way to one of the most beautiful sunrise that you would see in Maharashtra.

P.S. It is "perfectly" safe to camp their at night. Please don't plan a bonfire as it would be a risk to everyone (it would get really windy). Also, carry additional clothing and sheets as it will get really cold at night. 

You can call me in case you have any further queries (now or on reaching the village). Cheers :D
